blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: In daily life, each person exhibits unique speaking habits, leading to subtle yet consistent lip-shape variations even when pronouncing the same word. Although recent talking head generation methods have achieved impressive visual fidelity and lip synchronization, they largely overlook user-specific customization, especially the motion patterns that characterize individual speaking habits. These habits are difficult to model and capture, as their motion patterns are highly fine-grained and often similar across individuals. As a result, many approaches produce overly uniform facial motions and fail to capture diverse, person-specific articulation patterns. To address this, we propose TalkLikeYou, an efficient framework that imitates how a target person speaks in talking head generation. Our method models habit in motion-space and achieves real-time performance through Flow Matching with only one sampling step during inference. We further adopt a two-stage imitation learning strategy to capture subtle distinctions between habits, allowing users to specify a target habit through either a preset style from the dataset or a reference video. In addition, we introduce a new metric PLAD that projects mouth motions onto representative articulation axes to evaluate imitation accuracy and generation diversity. Extensive experiments demonstrate that TalkLikeYou generates high-quality talking heads in real-time and significantly improves speaking habit imitation compared with prior methods.
blocks.zh: 在日常生活中,每个人展现出独特的说话习惯,导致微妙而一致的唇形变化,即使在发音相同词时也是如此. 虽然最近的口语头部生成方法取得了令人印象深刻的视觉忠心和口语同步,但它们在很大程度上忽略了用户特有定制,尤其是个人口语习惯所特有的运动模式. 这些习惯很难建模和捕捉,因为它们的运动模式高度精细,并且往往在个体间相似. 因此,许多方法产生过于统一的面部运动并未能捕捉出多样,针对个人的表达模式. 为了解决这个问题,我们提出Talk Like You, 一个能模仿目标人物在谈论头代时如何说话的有效框架。 我们的方法模型习惯于运动空间,通过在推论中仅用一个采样步骤来进行流相匹配,实现实时性能. 我们进一步采取两阶段的模仿学习策略,以捕捉习惯之间的细微区别,让用户通过数据集的预设样式或参考视频来指定目标习惯. 此外,我们引入了一个新的指标PLAD,将口腔运动投射到具有代表性的表达轴上,以评价仿真准确性和生成多样性。 广泛实验证明,Talk Like 与前作方法相比,你实时生成出高质量的说话头并显著地改进了说话习惯模仿.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Audio-driven talking head generation has attracted increasing attention due to its wide range of applications, including digital humans, voice assistants, and film-making. With rapid progress in this field Wang et al. (2024) ; Zhao et al. (2025) , customization has become an important direction for meeting user-specific needs, including imitating how a target person speaks. Such imitation is essential for building personalized virtual avatars that convey a recognizable identity and leave a vivid impression on viewers, as each person’s speaking habits are reflected in subtle yet consistent articulatory behaviors in how the lips open, close, stretch, and transition during speech. As shown in Fig. 1 (a), even the same word can exhibit slight variations in articulation across individuals, such as the degree of mouth opening when saying “b u s”, the lip width when pronouncing “l ea ve”, or the pursing of the lips when saying “f oo d”. These diverse habitual motion patterns are important parts of how we perceive identity and personality in daily communication Dobs et al. (2016) .
blocks.zh: 音频驱动的语音头部生成因其广泛的应用,包括数字人,语音助理,和电影制作,而引起了越来越多的关注. 随着这一领域的迅速进展,王等 (2024年);赵等. (2025年),定制已经成为满足用户特定需要的重要方向,包括模仿目标人如何说话. 这种模仿对于建立个人化的虚拟活字画至关重要,这些虚拟活字画传达了可识别的身份,给观众留下了生动的印象,因为每个人的演讲习惯都体现在唇部的开口、相近、伸展和口语过渡中微妙而一致的动画行为上。 如图1(a)所示,即使同一词在表达上也可能在个人之间出现细微差异,例如,在说“b u s”时口腔开口的程度、在发音“l ea ve”时口腔宽度,或在说“f oo d”时口腔宽度。 这些不同的惯常运动模式是我们如何看待日常通信中的身份和人格的重要组成部分。

blocks.en: Yet imitating a person’s speaking habits remains challenging, as they involve fine-grained lip motion patterns that are difficult to model . Previous methods Ji et al. (2025) ; Wang et al. (2025b) ; Cui et al. (2025) ; Ki et al. (2025) have made significant progress in generation quality, but they primarily focus on synchronizing lip movements with audio while overlooking subtle motion differences among individuals. They rely on image-space diffusion and typically learn average motion patterns from the dataset without explicitly distinguishing between speakers, resulting in limited diversity and personalization in lip motion. They also suffer from limited efficiency, as they require multiple sampling steps in high-dimensional spaces. Moreover, the differences between habitual motion patterns are often subtle, making them difficult for models to capture . Although some methods Ma et al. (2023a) ; Ye et al. (2024) explore person-specific motion generation, they face limitations in imitation quality and motion coherence or rely on separate training for each individual. In addition, existing metrics are not designed to measure speaking-habit similarity and diversity. As a result, habit-aware talking-head generation remains underexplored.
blocks.zh: 但模仿一个人的口语习惯仍然具有挑战性,因为它们涉及难以模仿的细腻口语运动模式。 之前的方法Ji等 (2025年); Wang等 (2025年b); Cui等 (2025年); Ki等 (2025年) 在生成质量上取得了显著进步,但它们主要侧重于用音频来同步口腔运动,同时俯瞰个人之间的微妙运动差异. 它们依赖图像空间的传播,通常从数据集中学习平均运动规律,而没有明确区分扬声器,导致嘴唇运动的多样性和个人化程度有限. 它们的效率也有限,因为它们需要在高维空间采取多个取样步骤。 此外,习惯运动模式之间的差别往往微妙,使模型难以捕捉到。 虽然有些方法是Ma等人(2023a); Ye等人(2024年)探索个人特有运动生成,他们在模仿质量和运动一致性方面面临限制,或依靠对每个人的单独训练. 此外,现有的衡量标准不是用来衡量语言和语言的相似性和多样性的。 因此,认识到习惯的谈话头一代人仍然没有得到充分探讨。

blocks.zh: 图1:Talk Like You概览. 以前的方法往往产生统一的动议,对发言习惯的控制有限. 我们提议谈像 您在谈论头代时高效的习惯模仿, 以及一个新的衡量 PLAD 来评价习惯的相似性和多样性。

blocks.en: To address these issues, we propose TalkLikeYou, an efficient talking head generation framework designed to imitate and control individual speaking habits, as shown in Fig. 1 (b). To model speaking habits, our framework performs generation in motion space, providing better controllability, temporal coherence, and efficiency than image-space diffusion approaches Tian et al. (2024) ; Ji et al. (2025) . Specifically, we first generate expressive head motions conditioned on target habitual motion and then render them into the final talking-head video. By incorporating Flow Matching Lipman et al. (2022) for motion synthesis, our method generates motions with a single sampling step during inference, enabling real-time performance.
blocks.zh: 为了解决这些问题,我们提议采用Talk Like You,这是一个有效的头代对话框架,旨在模仿和控制个人说话习惯,如图1(b)所示。 为了模拟演讲习惯,我们的框架在运动空间中进行生成,提供更好的可控性、时间一致性和效率,比图像空间传播方法Tian等人(2024年);Ji等人(2025年)。 具体地说,我们首先产生以目标惯性运动为条件的表达式头部运动,然后将它们制成最后的说话头视频. 通过将Flow Matching Lipman等人(2022年)纳入运动合成,我们的方法在推论中以单一的取样步骤产生运动,使实时性能得以实现.

blocks.en: To capture fine-grained speaking-habit features for faithful imitation, we adopt a two-stage imitation learning strategy and establish a unified habit space using reference motion sequences and preset habit codes from the dataset. In the first stage, we initially train with only one-hot habit codes, as their explicit distinctions make habit differences easier for the model to learn. After this warm-up, we align reference-based habit features with their corresponding one-hot embeddings, then train on a large-scale video dataset in the second stage to improve generalization and diversity. This also allows our model to handle two scenarios: users can specify the target habit through a reference video or select a preset habit when no reference is available. It enables diverse and customizable generation while maintaining faithful speaking-habit imitation and accurate lip synchronization.
blocks.zh: 为了捕捉忠实模仿的精致口语居住特征,我们采用两相相仿的学习策略,并利用参考运动序列和数据集预设的习惯代码建立统一的习惯空间. 在第一阶段,我们最初只用一热的习惯规范来训练,因为它们的明显区别使得习惯差异更容易被模型所学习. 在此热身后,我们将基于参考的习惯特征与相应的一热嵌入相配合,然后在第二阶段在大型视频数据集上进行训练,以提高通俗化和多样性. 这也让我们的模型可以处理两种情景:用户可以通过一个参考视频来指定目标习惯,或者在没有参考时选择一个预设习惯. 它可以使一代人多样化和定制,同时保持忠实的口语模仿和准确的口语同步。

blocks.en: To measure the quality of speaking habit imitation and generation diversity, we introduce a new metric Projected Lip-Articulation Distribution (PLAD) as shown in Fig. 1 (c). Since speaking habits are reflected in subtle variations in lip articulation, we project motion sequences onto three representative articulation axes and characterize the resulting distributions using histograms. As these distributions become stable for sufficiently long sequences, we compute similarity and diversity scores from histograms to quantitatively evaluate speaking-habit imitation and generation diversity.
blocks.zh: 为了衡量口语习惯模仿和生成多样性的质量,我们引入了图1(c)所示的新的计量预测口语艺术分布。 由于口语习惯在口语拼接中表现出细微的变化,我们把运动序列投射到三个具有代表性的拼接轴上,并用直方图描述由此产生的分布. 随着这些分布在足够长的序列中变得稳定,我们计算出从直方图到定量评价语音-居住模仿和生成多样性的相似性和多样性分数.

blocks.en: In summary, our contributions are as follows:
blocks.zh: 总之,我们的贡献如下:

blocks.en: • We propose TalkLikeYou, a real-time talking-head generation framework capable of imitating specific speaking habits. By applying Flow Matching in motion space, our approach enables one-step motion generation with high coherence and efficiency. • To improve imitation quality, we design a unified habit space and adopt a two-stage imitation learning strategy to improve imitation generalization and diversity. • We develop a new metric PLAD to evaluate imitation quality by projecting motion sequences onto lip-articulation axes and measuring similarity and diversity across the histograms. • Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance in talking-head generation, with superior lip synchronization and speaking-habit imitation.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Audio-Driven Talking Head Generation
blocks.zh: 2.1 音频驱动说话头一代

blocks.en: Talking head generation aims to synthesize realistic facial animations with lip movements synchronized to input audio. Early methods Wang et al. (2025a) ; Zhang et al. (2024) mainly focus on lower-face synthesis for video dubbing, such as Wav2Lip Prajwal et al. (2020) , which introduces a lip-sync expert network to improve synchronization. Recent approaches utilize modern generative models for better quality. For example, Sonic Ji et al. (2025) and FLOAT Ki et al. (2025) adopt DiT Peebles and Xie (2023) as their backbone, while MultiTalk Kong et al. (2025) is built upon the video generation model WAN Wan et al. (2025) . However, these approaches often rely on heavy architectures, leading to high computational cost and long inference time. Moreover, they provide limited controllability for fine-grained motion patterns such as speaking habits.
blocks.zh: 说话头代旨在合成现实的面部动画,并用唇动向同步输入音频. 早期方法 王等 (2025a) ; 陈克. 张等 (2024)主要以下相合成为视频杜撰为主,如Wav2Lip Prajwal等 (2020),引入了唇形合成专家网络来改进同步性. 最近的办法利用现代基因模型提高质量。 例如,Sonic Ji等人(2025年)和FLOAT Ki等人(2025年)将DiT Peebles和Xie(2023年)作为骨干,而MultiTalk Kong等人(2025年)则以视频生成模型WAN Wan等(2025年)为基础. 然而,这些方法往往依赖于沉重的架构,导致计算成本高和推断时间长. 此外,它们为诸如演讲习惯等精细受精的运动模式提供了有限的可控性.

blocks.en: In parallel, two-stage pipelines have gained attention. They first predict intermediate facial motion representations from audio, such as 3DMM parameters Li et al. (2017) or facial landmarks, and then render lip-synced videos conditioned on them. Among these representations, implicit keypoints show strong expressiveness: face-vid2vid Wang et al. (2021) disentangles them into expression and pose, while LivePortrait Guo et al. (2024) improves controllability with landmark-bounded keypoints. Several methods follow this paradigm: EAT Gan et al. (2023) suffers from limited visual quality, while VASA Xu et al. (2024) and Ditto Li et al. (2025) apply diffusion in motion space but require multiple sampling steps and tend to generate uniform motions without modeling speaking habits. PC-Talk Wang et al. (2025b) provides stronger control and lip synchronization, but its backbone limits generalization. Overall, two-stage methods remain promising, yet still leave room for improvement in efficiency and controllable habit-aware generation.
blocks.zh: 与此同时,两阶段管道也得到了关注。 他们首先从音频预测出中间面部运动表现,如3DMM参数Li等(2017年)或面部地标,再使唇形相声视频以他们为条件. 在这些表述中,隐含的关键点显示出强烈的表达性:face-vid2vid 王等编. (2021年)将它们分解为表达和姿势,而LivePortrait Guo等. (2024)用有地标界限的关键点来改进可控性. 几种方法遵循这一模式: Gan等编. (2023年)视觉质量有限,而VASA Xu等 (2024年)和Ditto Li等. (2025)在运动空间中应用扩散,但需要多个采样步骤,并往往产生统一的运动而无需建模演讲习惯. PC-Talk Wang等(2025b)提供了更强的控制与唇同步,但其骨干限制了通化. 总的来说,两阶段方法仍然很有希望,但仍留有余地来提高效率和创造可控的习惯。

blocks.en: 2.2 Customized Talking Head Generation
blocks.zh: 2.2 自定义说话头一代

blocks.en: Customization has attracted increasing attention in talking-head generation. Several methods focus on emotion control Gan et al. (2023) ; Tan et al. (2024) ; Wang et al. (2025b) , generating emotional talking-face videos where the emotion source is derived from labels or other inputs such as text and audio. Other works incorporate image editing into this task, including hair transfer Feng et al. (2025) ; Li et al. (2026) and face swapping Guan et al. (2024) for appearance modification. Some methods Zhu et al. (2025) ; Wang et al. (2026) further focus on multi-person conversation to improve interaction. However, these works mainly address high-level customization, such as emotion, appearance, or interaction, rather than fine-grained motion control.
blocks.zh: 定制化在对话头一代中引起了越来越多的关注. 有几种方法侧重于情绪控制 Gan 等 (2023) ; Tan 等 (2024) ; Wang 等 (2025b) ,生成情绪谈话面视频,其中情绪源出自标签或文字和音频等其它投入. 其他作品将图像编辑纳入这项工作,包括发相转出冯等 (2025);李等 (2026)和相相换出关等. (2024)用于外观修改. 有的方法有: 朱等 (2025年); 王等 (2026年) 进一步注重多人对话,改善互动. 然而,这些作品主要针对高层次的定制,如情感,外观,或互动,而不是精细的纹理运动控制.

blocks.en: Meanwhile, several methods explore more detailed customization, such as imitating person-specific motion patterns, but they still face limitations. StyleTalk Ma et al. (2023a) and DreamTalk Ma et al. (2023b) perform conditioned synthesis with specific motion patterns, yet their control mainly targets emotion-related dynamics rather than habit-related variations in lip shape and articulation. MimicTalk Ye et al. (2024) uses an autoregressive paradigm to reproduce person-specific habits, but it is person-dependent and requires training or adaptation for each individual, limiting generalization to unseen identities. PC-Talk Wang et al. (2025b) can generate style-conditioned results, but may suffer from subtle temporal jitter and unstable motion. Although some 3D facial animation methods Fan et al. (2022) ; Thambiraja et al. (2023) ; Zhou et al. (2025) also investigate this direction, their generated 3D motions cannot be directly applied to 2D talking-head generation. Overall, imitating how a target person speaks still leaves substantial room for improvement.
blocks.zh: 同时,有几种方法探索更为详细的定制,例如模仿个人特定运动模式,但它们仍然面临限制. 样式 Talk Ma等 (2023a)和DreamTalk Ma等 (2023b) 以特定的运动模式进行有条件的合成,然而它们的控制主要针对与情感相关的动态,而不是唇形和发音上与习惯相关的变化. 缩写 Ye等人(2024年)使用自相递进的范式来再现个人特有的习惯,但这种范式是依赖个人的,需要对每个人进行培训或改造,将通俗化限制在看不见的身份上. PC-Talk Wang等(2025b)可以产生有风格条件的结果,但可能遭受微妙的时间焦躁和不稳定的运动. 虽然一些3D面部动画方法Fan等 (2022年);Thambiraja等 (2023年);周等 (2025年)也调查了这个方向,但是它们产生的3D运动不能被直接应用于2D对话头一代. 总的来说,模仿目标人物的言行仍然留有很大的改进余地.

blocks.en: 3.2 Flow Matching Motion Generator
blocks.zh: 3.2 流程匹配运动生成器

blocks.en: Model Architecture. Our motion generator aims to produce talking motions that are synchronized with the input audio while reflecting the target speaking habit in the lip region. To this end, we employ a DiT Peebles and Xie (2023) composed of four progressive layers as shown in Fig. 2 (b). We first use self-attention to extract intrinsic motion representations, then apply audio cross-attention to incorporate audio features for synchronization. Next, we project either the input habit sequence or the preset one-hot habit code from the training dataset into a unified habit space, and fuse it through a habit-injection layer to enable target-habit imitation. Finally, a temporal attention layer refines sequence-level dynamics and improves temporal consistency. This design enables coherent talking motion generation while preserving the target speaking habit.
blocks.zh: 模型建筑. 我们的运动发生器旨在产生与输入音频同步的说话运动,同时反映嘴唇区域的目标说话习惯. 为此,我们采用了由图2(b)所示四个进步层组成的DiT Peebles和Xie(2023). 我们首先使用自觉来取出内在的运动表达,然后应用音频的交叉意向来包含音频功能进行同步. 接下来,我们将输入习惯序列或预设的一热习惯代码从训练数据集投放到一个统一的习惯空间中,并通过一个习惯注入层来将它相接而成,从而实现目标居住模仿. 最后,时间关注层会完善序列级动态,并增强时间一致性. 这种设计能够使对话运动产生一致,同时保持目标演讲习惯。

blocks.en: 3.3 Two-stage Habit Imitation Learning Strategy
blocks.zh: 3.3 两阶段哈比人模仿学习战略

blocks.en: Although our framework can generate motions with a target habit from a reference motion sequence, directly training the model from scratch with reference motion sequences leads to unsatisfactory habit imitation. This is because speaking habits are fine-grained lip region patterns that often appear as subtle pronunciation-dependent variations, making them difficult to extract from motion alone. In contrast, one-hot habit codes provide explicit and separable supervision, making habit distinctions easier to learn and naturally supporting preset habit control when no reference video is available. Based on this, we propose a two-stage habit imitation strategy, as shown in Fig. 2 (c), to improve habit imitation quality while preserving preset one-hot control.
blocks.zh: 虽然我们的框架能从参考运动序列中产生带有目标习惯的运动,但直接用参考运动序列从零开始训练模型会导致不令人满意的习惯模仿. 这是因为口语习惯是细腻的唇区图案,常以微妙的发音依赖变体而出现,使其难以单独从运动中取出. 相形之下,一热的习惯规范提供了明确而可分离的监督,使得习惯区分更容易学习,并且在没有参考视频时自然支持预先设定的习惯控制. 在此基础上,我们提出一个两阶段的习惯模仿战略,如图2(c)所示,以提高习惯模仿的质量,同时保留预先设定的一热控制.

blocks.en: ALGORITHM 1 Projected Lip-Articulation Distribution for Speaking-Habit Evaluation
blocks.zh: 阿尔及尔 1 预计的口语配音传播,用于语音节目评价

blocks.en: Existing talking head metrics mainly measure visual quality or lip synchronization, but are not designed to evaluate whether generated motion preserves a specific speaking habit. To evaluate speaking-habit imitation and generation diversity, we introduce Projected Lip-Articulation Distribution (PLAD). Since speaking habits are reflected in subtle and consistent lip articulations, PLAD projects motion sequences onto representative lip-articulation axes and characterizes the resulting distributions using histograms. We assume that a speaking habit is not determined by isolated frames, but by stable statistical tendencies over repeated articulatory movements. Although each frame is influenced by phonetic content, a person tends to show consistent distributional patterns over sufficiently long sequences along these representative axes such as mouth opening, lip stretching, or lip pursing. Thus, motions with the same habit should have similar PLAD histograms, while different habits should yield distinguishable distributions.
blocks.zh: 现存的说话头度量法主要衡量视觉质量或唇相同步,但并非旨在评价所生成的运动是否保留了特定的说话习惯. 为了评估语言-居住模仿和代代多样性,我们引入了预测的口腔-艺术分布。 由于口语习惯体现在微妙而一致的口语表达上,PLAD将运动序列投射到有代表性的口语表达轴上,并用直方图描述由此产生的分布. 我们假设,演讲习惯不是由孤立的框架决定的,而是由统计趋势稳定而不是反复的动脉运动决定的。 虽然每个框架都受到口腔内容的影响,但一个人倾向于在这些具有代表性的轴上,如口腔开口,口腔伸缩,或口腔伸缩等足够长的花序上显示一致的分布规律. 因此,具有相同习惯的运动应具有类似的PLAD直方图,而不同的习惯应产生可区分的分布.

blocks.en: Implementation Details. We convert all videos to 25 fps and extract audio and motion representations before training. (2021) in the first training stage, which contains high-quality videos of 380 identities, each represented by a one-hot code as a preset habit option. The second stage is trained on CelebV-HQ Zhu et al. (2022) , a large-scale in-the-wild talking head dataset. We adopt the Wav2Lip Prajwal et al. (2020) audio encoder for its audio-lip aligned features. More details are provided in the supplementary.

blocks.en: Quantitative Results. As shown in Tab. 1 , TalkLikeYou achieves strong overall performance on both HDTF and CelebV-HQ. It obtains the best Sync-C scores on both datasets, with Sync-D only slightly behind Sonic on HDTF, indicating accurate lip synchronization. blocks.en: Qualitative Results. As shown in Fig. 3 , we compare our method with other baselines under three speaking habits. Although these habits involve subtle lip-shape differences for the same pronunciation, our method consistently achieves accurate lip synchronization. In contrast, existing methods often produce unrealistic results: SadTalker produces rigid motions, while Hallo2 and Sonic show blurry teeth regions and unstable lip movements. FLOAT and Ditto yield clearer results, but their motions are less natural, with FLOAT producing limited mouth movements and Ditto often over-opening the mouth. The results show that incorporating this strategy improves the generalization of habit motion. In contrast, direct training tends to produce less mouth opening and more uniform motions. blocks.en: Flow Matching and DDIM with reparameterize. We conduct an ablation study on Flow Matching and reparameterization, as shown in Fig. 6 . Flow Matching maintains strong lip-sync performance across sampling steps, while the DDIM-based formulation is less stable, supporting the effectiveness of Flow Matching for efficient motion-space sampling and one-step generation. Removing reparameterization degrades both Flow Matching and DDIM, indicating that conventional velocity or noise prediction leads to unstable generation in our framework. In contrast, reparameterization improves sampling stability and yields clear performance gains. These results validate the importance of both components for accurate and efficient lip-synchronized motion generation.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: In this paper, we present TalkLikeYou, an efficient talking head generation framework for habit imitation. Our method focuses on generating talking head videos with specific speaking habits, providing flexible customization for user requirements. We use Flow Matching to generate motions conditioned on multiple habit sources, enabling efficient one-step sampling during inference. We further adopt a two-stage habit imitation learning strategy to improve habit generalization. To evaluate habit imitation quality, we propose a new metrics PLAD that measures motion similarity and diversity using histogram features from several representative motion axes. Extensive experiments show that our method achieves strong performance in talking head generation and habit imitation, validating the effectiveness of both our framework and the proposed metrics.

blocks.en: Appendix B Further Explanations

blocks.en: B.1 Speaking Habit Imitation
blocks.zh: B.1 说哈比人模仿

blocks.en: Speaking-habit imitation aims to generate talking-head videos that reflect how a target person speaks through characteristic facial behaviors, particularly lip movements. Current video generative models can produce high-fidelity videos but often struggle to capture these fine-grained, person-specific articulation patterns, which require focused modeling of the lip region. Therefore, we adopt a motion-based generation method and use implicit keypoints as the representation for their high expressiveness and landmark-based semantic constraints. Specifically, we introduce a landmark-guided loss during implicit keypoint learning to minimize the distance between projected implicit keypoints and 2D facial landmarks. These properties enable us to focus the motion generator on lip-region dynamics, improving speaking-habit imitation.
blocks.zh: Speak-habit模仿旨在生成能反映被攻击者如何通过特征面部行为,特别是唇动来说话的说话头视频. 目前的视频基因模型可以产生高真实度的视频,但往往难以捕捉出这些精细的,针对人物的表达模式,这需要对唇区进行有重点的模型. 因此,我们采用了一种基于运动的生成方法,并使用隐含的关键点来表示其高度的表达力和具有里程碑意义的语义限制。 具体地说,我们在隐含的关键点学习过程中引入了标志性引导损失,以将预测隐含的关键点和2D面部地标之间的距离最小化. 这些特性使我们能够将运动发生器的焦点放在唇区动态上,改进语音-居住模仿.

blocks.en: Several methods have explored speaker-dependent styles related to speaking habits. However, speaking styles and speaking habits describe different levels of behavior. Speaking style broadly characterizes the overall manner of speaking, including rhythm, intonation, emotion, and expressiveness, and can be shared across individuals. In contrast, speaking habits refer to subtle, person-specific articulation patterns that remain relatively consistent across utterances. In this work, we focus on these habitual lip-motion patterns, which capture finer-grained aspects of individual speaking behavior than overall speaking style.
blocks.zh: 几种方法探讨了与演讲习惯有关的依赖演讲者的风格. 然而,演讲风格和演讲习惯描述了不同层次的行为. 说话风格广义地描述说话的整体方式,包括节奏,入想,情感,和表现,可以被个人分享. 相形之下,演讲习惯是指各种语言之间相对一致的微妙、针对个人的表达模式。 在这部作品中,我们专注于这些习惯性的唇动模式,它们捕捉到个人说话行为的精细方面而不是整体说话风格.

blocks.en: B.2 Flow Matching
blocks.zh: B.2 流量匹配

blocks.en: Flow Matching is a generative modeling approach that learns a continuous velocity field to transform a noise distribution into a target data distribution. In our framework, it learns to transport noise to clean motion along a linear interpolation path. As shown in Fig. 7 (a), the RMSE relative to clean motion changes linearly with the timestep, whereas DDPM exhibits a nonlinear relationship under its noise schedule. This linear interpolation provides a more direct transport path, facilitating approximation of the learned dynamics with fewer sampling steps. In contrast, conventional diffusion sampling typically relies on repeated denoising updates to progressively recover motion from noise. By combining Flow Matching with direct clean-motion prediction, our generator further simplifies inference and produces the complete motion sequence in a single sampling step, supporting efficient, real-time generation.
blocks.zh: Flow Matching是一种基因模型化的方法,它学习了连续速度场将噪声分布转化为目标数据分布. 在我们的框架内,它学会了传播噪音 沿着线性插入路径清理运动。 如图7(a)所示,RMSE相对于清洁运动,随时间步变化而呈线性变化,而DDPM则在其噪声表下表现出非线性关系. 这种线性插值提供了更直接的运输路径,便于以较少的采样步骤来接近所学的动态. 相形之下,传统的扩散取样通常依赖反复的去诺更新,以逐步从噪音中恢复运动。 通过将"流相匹配"和"直接清洁-运动预测"相结合,我们的发电机进一步简化了推论,在单一的取样步骤中产生完整的运动序列,支持高效,实时的生成.

blocks.en: B.3 PLAD Evaluation
blocks.zh: B.3. PLAD 评价

blocks.en: Our proposed PLAD uses three representative lip-articulation axes to characterize motion sequences through projection histograms: mouth opening, lip pursing, and lip widening. We consider these axes sufficient to capture key characteristics of speaking habits, as they represent common articulation patterns in daily communication, and many lip configurations can be approximated by their linear combinations. These axes thus provide a compact coordinate system for describing lip motion, analogous to the three spatial coordinates. The histogram along each axis reflects a person’s habitual articulation tendencies in the corresponding dimension, collectively characterizing their speaking habit.

blocks.en: C.2 PLAD Algorithm
blocks.zh: C.2 PLAD 算法

blocks.en: We evaluate speaking-habit similarity and generation diversity separately. For similarity, we first extract lip motions from the generated and reference videos using the motion extractor, then construct three projection histograms for each sequence following the procedure described in the main paper. Each sequence contains at least 500 frames, corresponding to 20 seconds at 25 fps, to obtain stable distribution estimates. We then compute histogram IoU and JS distance between the corresponding generated and reference histograms. We represent each histogram as an array of normalized bin values, allowing direct computation without additional sampling. For diversity, we evaluate more than 50 generated videos and compute the average pairwise JS distance between their PLAD descriptors. This score measures the distributional differences among generated motions in the lip-articulation space, with higher values indicating more diverse speaking habits.
blocks.zh: 我们分别评价语言-居住相似性和世代多样性。 为了相似性,我们首先利用运动提取器从生成的视频和参考视频中提取出唇动能,然后按照正文所描述的程序为每个序列构建出三个投影直方图. 每个序列包含至少500个帧,对应于25 fps的20秒以获得稳定的分布估计. 然后我们计算出直方图IoU和JS在相应的生成和参考直方图之间的距离。 我们代表每个直方图,作为一系列正常的bin值,允许在没有额外采样的情况下直接计算。 为了多样性,我们评价了50多段生成的视频,并计算了PLAD描述符之间平均对等的JS距离。 这个分数衡量了在唇形演化空间中产生的运动之间的分布差异,更高的值表明说话习惯更加多样化.

blocks.en: C.3 Implementation Settings
blocks.zh: C.3 执行设置

blocks.en:
We preprocess all videos at 25 fps and extract their audio and motion representations before training. The Flow Matching Motion Generator operates on 18-dimensional lip-motion features and takes a 100-frame reference motion sequence for habit conditioning. The generated motions are then rendered into 512 × 512 512\times 512 videos using rendering modules initialized from LivePortrait Guo et al. (2024) , which offers a favorable balance between efficiency and visual quality. These rendering modules remain fixed while we optimize the motion generator. The motion extractor is also initialized with LivePortrait.
We use 1000 flow-matching timesteps and train the generator with Adam Kingma and Ba (2014) at a learning rate of 1 × 10 − 4 1\times 10^{-4} . The two training stages take 48 and 72 hours, respectively, on a single RTX 3090 GPU. The first stage uses HDTF Zhang et al. (2021) , which contains high-quality videos of 380 identities, each assigned a one-hot code as a preset habit option. The second stage uses CelebV-HQ Zhu et al. (2022) , a large-scale, in-the-wild talking-face dataset, to improve generalization. Throughout training and inference, we use the Wav2Lip Prajwal et al. (2020) audio encoder to extract features aligned with lip movements.

blocks.en: At inference time, our framework achieves 32 FPS with one-step Flow Matching sampling. The rendering pipeline animates a cropped face region and stitches it back into the original frame, supporting both image animation and video dubbing. Before animation, we apply a neutralization procedure to establish a consistent initial lip configuration and mouth-opening distance across identities, reducing the effects of imperfect disentanglement in implicit keypoints. The neutral face retains a slightly open mouth to provide a visible reference for the teeth, helping our warp-based renderer preserve tooth structure and maintain temporal consistency throughout the video.
blocks.zh: 推论一下,我们的框架实现了32个FPS, 单步流匹配抽样。 渲染管动画将被收割后的脸部区域缝合回原相框中,支持图像动画和视频相接. 在动画前,我们采用中和程序来建立一致的初始唇构型和跨身份开口相距,减少隐含键位中不完美分解的影响. 中性面部保留了略开口为牙齿提供可见的参考,帮助我们以曲速为主的渲染器保存了牙齿结构并在整个视频中保持了时间上的一致性.

blocks.en: D.1 Analysis on Generation Diversity
blocks.zh: D.1 对世代多样性的分析

blocks.en: We use videos generated by other methods as references to investigate whether different methods exhibit distinguishable motion patterns. As shown in Fig. 7 (b), the four methods exhibit distinct distributions in the PLAD space. Sonic tends to produce stronger projections along the lip-pursing axis, which may partly explain its high lip-sync scores if the synchronization metric favors such articulation patterns. Hallo2 tends to generate wider mouth movements, whereas FLOAT and Ditto produce smaller lip movements with more concentrated distributions. These differences suggest that each method implicitly learns characteristic lip-motion patterns, analogous to the distinct speaking habits of individuals. More importantly, our method can use these generated videos as references and adapt to their corresponding motion distributions. This shows that TalkLikeYou is not limited to real-world human reference videos, but can also capture method-specific motion patterns from AI-generated videos. In this sense, our framework provides a flexible platform to bridge the motion-distribution gap across different methods and generate talking motions with controllable, method-like speaking habits.
blocks.zh: 我们使用其他方法生成的视频作为参考,来调查不同方法是否表现出可区分的运动规律. 如图7(b)所示,这四种方法在PLAD空间有不同的分布。 索尼克倾向于沿着唇光轴产生更强的预测,如果同步度量有利于这种表达模式,这可以部分解释其高唇合成分数. hallo2倾向于产生更宽的口部运动,而FLOAT和Ditto则产生更集中分布的更小的口部运动. 这些差异表明,每一种方法都隐含地学习了典型的唇动模式,类似于个人独特的说话习惯. 更重要的是,我们的方法可以使用这些生成的视频作为参考,并适应它们相应的运动发行. 这表明"Talk Like You"并不限于现实世界的人类参考视频,还可以从AI生成的视频中捕捉出特定方法的运动模式. 从这个意义上讲,我们的框架提供了一个灵活的平台来弥合不同方法之间的运动分配差距并产生具有可控、类似方法的演讲习惯的谈话运动。

blocks.en: D.2 Visualization of the Habit Space

blocks.en: As shown in Fig. 7 (c), we visualize the unified habit space using t-SNE, where stars represent preset one-hot habit features and dots represent features extracted from reference videos. Reference features associated with the same identity cluster around their corresponding preset feature, while different identities form distinct clusters. This suggests that our two-stage learning strategy aligns the two types of habit representations while preserving distinctions among speaking habits, supporting both reference-based imitation and preset habit control within a shared space. Furthermore, by interpolating between two points in the habit space, we can generate a new speaking habit that combines characteristics of both, enabling users to customize speaking habits by blending multiple sources.
blocks.zh: 如图7(c)所示,我们使用t-SNE来视觉统一习惯空间,其中恒星代表预设的一热习惯特征和点代表从参考视频中提取的特征. 与相同身份集群相关的参考特征围绕其相应的预设特征,而不同身份则形成不同的集群. 这表明,我们的两阶段学习战略协调了两种类型的习惯表现,同时保持发言习惯的区别,支持基于参考的模仿和共享空间内预先设定的习惯控制。 此外,通过在习惯空间的两点之间插入,我们可以产生一种结合两者特点的新说话习惯,使用户能够通过混合多种来源来自定义说话习惯.

blocks.en: D.3 User Study
blocks.zh: D.3 用户研究

blocks.en: We conduct a user study to evaluate five key dimensions: lip synchronization, image quality, temporal consistency, habit imitation, and overall realism. For each method, we use 10 generated video clips, each lasting more than 5 seconds. The questionnaire follows the Mean Opinion Score protocol with a five-point scale (1–5), where higher scores indicate better performance, and involves more than 20 participants. As shown in Tab. 3 , TalkLikeYou achieves the highest scores across all evaluated dimensions, demonstrating its effectiveness in talking-head generation. In particular, our method performs well in habit imitation, faithfully reproducing target speaking habits while maintaining accurate lip synchronization, high visual quality, and temporal consistency. These results further validate the effectiveness of TalkLikeYou in generating realistic, habit-aware talking-head videos.

blocks.en: Limitations and Future Work. While our method can generate talking faces with specific speaking habits, it may struggle to maintain motion stability for exaggerated articulation patterns, such as excessively wide mouth openings. Our framework also focuses primarily on the mouth region, where speaking habits are readily observable, rather than modeling person-specific behaviors across the entire face. In the future, we will explore incorporating eye movements and head pose dynamics to capture a more comprehensive range of individual speaking behaviors.
blocks.zh: 限制和未来工作。 虽然我们的方法可以产生有具体说话习惯的说话面孔,但为了夸张的表达模式,例如口腔开口过宽,可能难以保持运动稳定性. 我们的框架也主要关注口腔区域,在口腔区,口腔习惯很容易被观察到,而不是在整个面孔上模拟针对个人的行为. 未来,我们将探索整合眼动和头姿动能,以捕捉更为全面的个体说话行为.

blocks.en: Ethical Considerations. Our method generates high-fidelity talking-face videos that imitate a target person’s speaking habits. Since these habits are recognizable aspects of individual behavior, we acknowledge the potential ethical risks and societal concerns associated with misuse, particularly on public platforms. To help mitigate these risks, we are committed to responsible research dissemination, supporting advances in deepfake detection, and promoting the safe and ethical use of generative media technologies.
blocks.zh: 道德考虑。 我们的方法产生高性能的谈话相片, 由于这些习惯是个人行为的可识别方面,我们承认与滥用有关的潜在道德风险和社会关切,特别是在公共平台上。 为了帮助减轻这些风险,我们致力于负责任的研究传播,支持在深假检测方面取得的进展,并提倡安全和合乎道德地使用基因媒体技术。
